stories.h: Exquisite X-rays and dynamic compression initiate a new era of physics experiments on plutonium
stories.t: Scientists at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL), Argonne National Laboratory (ANL) and Washington State University (WSU) have conducted the first dynamic compression experiments on plutonium at a national light source facility, the Dynamic Compression Sector (DCS).

stories.h: Elon Musk tries to explain what’s going on with Ukraine and Starlink
stories.t: Elon Musk said Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy is lying about disruptions to Starshield in Ukraine and that he's trying to misuse SpaceX's consumer service, Starlink, for military purposes.

stories.h: New discovery reveals what may be holding back room-temperature superconductors
stories.t: A major breakthrough in superconductivity research has revealed that one of the essential ingredients for electricity to flow without resistance can exist at room temperature.
